title: @inth/react: React cookie banner and cookie consent components
description: React cookie banner, consent dialog, and preference center for React 18 and 19. Each visitor's consent policy decides whether optional cookies wait for an opt-in, as EU cookie rules require, or load until the visitor opts out. Use headless hooks when you want your own design.
features: Works with React 18 and 19, including React Server Components through 'use client' entry points
Prebuilt cookie banner, consent dialog, and preference center with a theme system
Headless hooks and compound components for a fully custom design
Analytics, ads, and pixels follow each visitor's choice through @inth/integrations: Google Tag Manager, Google Consent Mode v2, GA4, Meta Pixel, PostHog, and more
IAB TCF 2.4 banner, dialog, and hooks through the @inth/react/iab subpath
prerequisites: An [Inth project](https://inth.com) (free sign-up), a [self-hosted backend](https://c15t.com/docs/self-host/quickstart), or local mode for development and tests
manualInstallation: Then add the prebuilt stylesheet to your app-level CSS entry point:
If you use the prebuilt IAB TCF UI, also import `@inth/react/iab/styles.css`. It is published separately so apps without IAB do not ship those styles.
usage: Wrap your app in `ConsentProvider` with the backend URL from your Inth project
Render `ConsentBanner`, `ConsentDialog` and `ConsentDialogLink` inside the provider, and mount it once for the life of the app
For the full setup, see the [React quickstart](https://c15t.com/docs/frameworks/react/quickstart)
